name: Fair City
description: The day-to-day dramas of the community who live and work in the fictional north Dublin suburb of Carrigstown.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Floyd takes Jimmy to task for telling Robin his secret. Chloe tells the band that the record company wants to see them without Shay.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Floyd's sincerity about his relationship with Heather touches Robin. Chloe and the band go to England to see the record company. Alan agrees to bring Robin to visit Liam in hospital.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Having been shocked by news of the claim against the garage, Molloy and Jimmy discuss their options. Det. Sgt. Byrne can't believe it when he catches Jenny sneaking a boy out of her bedroom. Chloe has bad news for Shay.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Molloy suggests to Alan that the garage settle out of court while Robin's guilt grows. Shay admits his disappointment to Carol about losing the band. Det. Sgt. Byrne asks Tracey to advise Kim on her options.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Dean is freaked to get a chilling phone call from Fergal. Sharon counsels Erica not to fall out with Doug over tensions in the house. Mairead confides in Orla that money troubles have forced her and Damien to cancel a trip to see Saoirse. Hayley’s scheme to get vengeance on James is turned upside down by Maxine’s arrival to help out at the raffle.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: A troublemaking Fergal drops a bombshell to Gar before the engagement party. Hayley sets her plan to take down James in motion. Erica upsets the men in her life when she can’t help showing just how sick of Pete she is. Orla makes a startling discovery about Mairead.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Hayley’s plan to rig the raffle and blame James crashes and burns. Pete hides his sadness and celebrates Erica and Doug’s thrilling news. When Damien discovers the hole in their finances, he accuses Mairead of prioritising her child over his. Dearbhla implores Gar to give her a second chance, but Fergal stokes the situation with more lies.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Hayley is shocked when a fight with James leads to something more. Old feelings stir in Orla when Damien leans on her over his troubles with Mairead. Dean tries to subtly warn Dearbhla that Fergal is getting into Gar’s head. Erica is shocked when she catches Pete out in his painkiller use.

videos.title: Episode 148
videos.overview: Dean and Mairead’s Christmas is disrupted by Damien’s surprise return. Carol and JJ’s festive romance hits a stumbling block. Emma is horrified as James’s party guest is not the girl next door she thought she was. Steo saves Christmas for Greg. Carol publicly humiliates James. As the Christmas lights twinkle, Tyler plots revenge.

videos.title: Episode 149
videos.overview: Tyler’s twisted plan has dire consequences for Damien. JJ pursues romance but Carol keeps her eye on the prize when she decides to sell the bookies. Emma encourages a broken James to get on with his life post-Hayley.

videos.title: Episode 116
videos.overview: Just as Pete and Dolores stop being suspiciousabout her, Erica allows herself to get closer to Philip. Hayley rocks James when she reveals herprice of access to the baby.

videos.title: Episode 117
videos.overview: Hayley is out for blood when James pushes her too far. Erica's wedding nerves go from bad to worse when Teri shows up unannounced.

videos.title: Episode 118
videos.overview: Ger puts an alternative plan in motion to deal with James permanently. As Erica throws herself into wedding preparations, Teri becomes suspicious of Philip.

videos.title: Episode 119
videos.overview: A fiery James walks right into Ger and Sharon's trap. Teri gives some surprising advice to a lovelorn Erica. Pete takes extreme measures to buy Hughie's classic car.

videos.title: Episode 120
videos.overview: Erica plays with fire, but who will get burnt? Hayley lands James in serious trouble when his temper gets the better of him. Lorcan and Ruby's joke backfires.

videos.title: Episode 121
videos.overview: Erica, on the eve of her wedding, has an agonising choice to make. Hayley is conflicted when Sharon softens her stance on James.

videos.title: Episode 122
videos.overview: As Erica and Doug prepare to walk down the aisle, Nikki makes a discovery that throws Doug into a spin. When Hayley's water breaks, a desperate James lies in order to be present.

videos.title: Episode 123
videos.overview: James and Doug race to rescue Hayley, and a heartbroken Doug is in turmoil when an emotional Erica begs him for forgiveness.

videos.title: Episode 124
videos.overview: James fears Hayley waking while Sharon maintains vigil in hospital. Ger demands revenge on James and finds an unexpected ally in Anto.

videos.title: Episode 126
videos.overview: Mairead urges Dean to be patient, but Damien is left suspicious by a strange phone call. Sharon is relieved when Hayley wakes but Anto and Ger can't drop their desire for vengeance.

videos.title: Episode 127
videos.overview: With Damien's suspicions rising, Mairead and Dean realise they are out of options. Despite his own heartbreak, a thoughtful Doug inspires Pete to follow his heart.

videos.title: Episode 128
videos.overview: Mairead lies that she never slept with Dean. Dean and Damien's feud explodes in public. Emma warns James that his behaviour will lose him his child.

videos.title: Episode 130
videos.overview: All Dean can do is look on, as Damien presses Mairead to come with him to Germany. James has taken care of Scout, but will that sway Hayley to show him some sympathy?

videos.title: Episode 131
videos.overview: Damien makes a shocking revelation to Dolores. Ellie gets closer to Greg. Hayley sticks to her guns about James. Melanie hits on a plan to solve her housing problem.

videos.title: Episode 132
videos.overview: Damien makes a new start. Greg struggles to deal with a smitten Ellie. Hayley's release from hospital has sombre consequences for James. Melanie's housing plan backfires.

videos.title: Episode 133

videos.title: Episode 134
videos.overview: Melanie puts her devious plan to secure free accommodation into action. Ger tackles the Collins family's overcrowding crisis. Sharon, urged on by Emma, suggests Hayley allow James spend time with the baby.

videos.title: Episode 135
videos.overview: Melanie's plans hit a snag as Gwen plays her at her own game. Money worries bedevil the Mullens'. Hayley struggles with her recovery as Anto is confronted with the harm his actions caused.

videos.title: Episode 137
videos.overview: A scrambling Melanie covers she is using the office as a living space. As Pete slags Paul over his single status, Paul decides to get back in the dating game.

videos.title: Episode 138
videos.overview: A defeated Paul is oblivious as Steo gets him in his sights. Victor works with Anto to give Babs the perfect homecoming, but she is not pleased about how he did things.

videos.title: Episode 139
videos.overview: Steo thinks he might have a way to off load his stolen wine, but Paul has other ideas. Kira's attempt to help Melanie out fails to build bridges.

videos.title: Episode 140
videos.overview: Paul realises he needs a partner. Gwen has to improvise to keep the house together. Nora comes to the rescue.

videos.title: Episode 141
videos.overview: Gwen's curiosity is piqued when Fergal receives a mystery package in the post. Carol, spinning plates when her taxi app goes down, appeals to Paul and Hughie for help.

videos.title: Episode 142

videos.title: Episode 143
videos.overview: The Collins family have it out once and for all, but can they move on from the past? Kira gets busted by Juliet while Paul clashes with Steo over the stolen wine.

videos.title: Episode 144
videos.overview: The Colins family scramble to stop Anto from telling the truth about the fire. Paul goes to great lengths not to be outdone by Mondo.

videos.title: Episode 145

videos.title: Episode 148
videos.overview: The Collins' react badly when Mondo fails to take Claire's advice. Hayley makes a startling announcement to the community. Pete and Dolores get a date for their divorce but will they go through with it?

videos.title: Episode 150
videos.overview: Kira must decide if she must confess to Mondo. Steo makes a troubling discovery about JJ Pete realises he has made a terrible mistake.

videos.title: Episode 151
videos.overview: Mondo shocks his family when he blames Anto for what he did to him. Pete's plan to save his marriage seems doomed. Lorcan reveals his fears for JJ's future.

videos.title: Episode 152
videos.overview: Pete is fearful of a rejection from Dolores. Jacinta saves the day. Melanie fears Mondo's admission will mean a jail sentence. JJ's amusement at Steo's fears causes a rift.

videos.title: Episode 153
videos.overview: Kira and Juliet fail to stop Mondo seeing nasty graffiti outside Comet, but their support galvanises him. Dean realises how much he misses Damien as Mairead urges him to open up.

videos.title: Episode 161
videos.overview: J.J. does Zak a favour. Phoebe refuses to slow down after her injury. Emma tries to intervene in James's love life. Jess offers Zoe some work.

videos.title: Episode 163
videos.overview: Zak remains eager to join JJ's poker game. Zak grows suspicious of Gwen's interest in James. Dean and Mairead feel Phoebe's anger.

videos.title: Episode 164
videos.overview: As tensions escalate, James hatches a drastic plan to thwart Zak. A mischievous Fergal also sets out to scupper Zak.

videos.title: Episode 165
videos.overview: A cash-strapped Paul is drawn in when Steo proposes a shady scheme. Cass finds the perfect Christmas gift for Darren, but Ger won't budge on price.

videos.title: Episode 166
videos.overview: Tommy is unimpressed with Emma's treatment of him in front of her clients. Paul has a close shave with a curious Garda Knowles.

videos.title: Episode 167
videos.overview: Sash is horrified to discover who Zak's new partner in McCoy's is. Emma discovers that James is the cause of Ger's animosity. Paul lands on the wrong side of Garda Knowles.

videos.title: Episode 168
videos.overview: Zak warns a furious Sash she needs to change tack with James. Meanwhile JJ, eyes on the prize, watches from the shadows. Emma goes to war with Ger.

videos.title: Episode 169
videos.overview: Hayley returns to Carrigstown with a surprising request for James. How will he respond? Cass Coaches Darren for his school play audition.

videos.title: Episode 173
videos.overview: James makes a huge mistake when he attacks Hayley for planning to abscond with Scout on Christmas Day. Steo is forced into a dodgy deal with Paul.

videos.title: Episode 174
videos.overview:
James fears he could lose his rights to Scout when Hayley discovers she has been conned. Steo

threatens dire consequences for Paul if he agrees to a deal with JJ.

videos.title: Episode 175
videos.overview: James is determined to win Hayley's heart, but will he succeed? Steo gets wind of Paul's betrayal and exacts revenge. It's a tense Christmas Day in the Cassidy household.
